relay.page.title: 8-Leg Relay: Which One Is AI?
relay.home.heading: 8-Leg Relay
relay.past_scrolls.label: Past scrolls
relay.the_strip_on_the_left_is_the_last_: The strip on the left is the last 6 columns of the previous leg. Start drawing right of the dashed line so the two legs connect.
relay.shortcuts_b_pen_e_eraser_g_fill_i_: Shortcuts: B pen, E eraser, G fill, I picker (or Alt+click), L line, U rect, O ellipse, H hand (or hold Space), [ ] brush size, Ctrl+Z undo, Shift+click for a straight line.
relay.pinch_to_zoom_drag_with_two_finger: Pinch to zoom, drag with two fingers to pan.
relay.others_will_only_see_in_progress_w: Others will only see “in progress”. When the previous leg is done, give a screenshot of its tail to an image tool, then upload the result. Stray single pixels are removed on upload.
relay.use_this_image_as_the_ai_leg: Use this image as the AI leg
relay.without_an_api_key_copy_the_instru: Without an API key: copy the instructions into a Claude chat, then paste the JSON it returns below.
relay.use_these_strokes_as_the_ai_leg: Use these strokes as the AI leg
relay.ai_artist_no_8_is_hiding_in_these_: AI artist “No. 8” is hiding in these 8 legs and drew just one. Nobody knows which until the reveal. Find it.
relay.your_pick.label: Your pick
relay.pre_voting_opens_after_leg_2_is_co: Pre-voting opens after leg 2 is complete.
relay.i_think_this_is_the_ai_selected: I think this is the AI (selected)
relay.i_think_this_is_the_ai: I think this is the AI
relay.this_scroll_is_revealed_or_view_on: This scroll is revealed or view-only.
relay.no_legs_are_finished_yet_rating_an: No legs are finished yet. Rating and guessing open once leg 1 is done.
relay.ai_question_optional_voting_does_n: AI question (optional; voting does not depend on it)
relay.what_do_you_think_of_things_made_b: What do you think of things made by AI? (1 very bad, 5 very good)
relay.you_have_view_only_access_and_cann: You have view-only access and cannot submit.
relay.submitted_you_can_change_your_rati: Submitted. You can change your ratings and guess until the reveal. Rate new legs as they finish.
relay.pick_a_leg_as_the_ai_first: Pick a leg as the AI first
relay.the_answer_is_out_submit_to_see_it: The answer is out. Submit to see it.
relay.reveal_leg_was_drawn_by_ai_artist_: Reveal: leg {valueA} was drawn by AI artist “No. 8”
relay.before_the_reveal_of_guessed_right: Before the reveal, {valueB} of {valueA} guessed right
relay.before_the_reveal_the_ai_leg_avera: Before the reveal, the AI leg averaged {valueA} and ranked #{valueB} of 8.
relay.people_re_rated_the_ai_leg_after_t: {valueA} people re-rated the AI leg after the reveal: {valueB} → {valueC}.
relay.more_submitted_after_the_reveal_an: {valueA} more submitted after the reveal and are not counted above.
relay.answer_two_questions_to_see_everyo: Answer two questions to see everyone’s results.
relay.now_how_would_you_rate_leg: Now how would you rate leg {valueA}?
relay.what_do_you_think_of_things_made_b: What do you think of things made by AI?
relay.only_people_who_have_submitted_a_g: Only people who have submitted a guess can see this, to avoid spoilers.
relay.how_did_you_guess_up_to_140_charac: How did you guess? (up to 140 characters)
relay.brush.label: Brush+
relay.color.label: Color
relay.submit_failed_tap_submit_this_leg_: Submit failed. Tap “Submit this leg” again.
relay.someone_is_taking_it_right_now_try: Someone is taking it right now. Try again in a few seconds.
relay.could_not_take_the_leg_try_again: Could not take the leg. Try again.
relay.you_already_drew_in_this_scroll: You already drew in this scroll
relay.scroll.label: Scroll
relay.sign_in_and_get_an_invite_from_the: Sign in and get an invite from the host to draw.
relay.you_have_view_only_access_ask_the_: You have view-only access. Ask the host to make you a Contributor in the share menu.
relay.submit.label: Submit
relay.you_already_drew_in_this_scroll_op: You already drew in this scroll. Open the next one?
relay.this_scroll_is_full_open_the_next_: This scroll is full. Open the next one?
relay.you_can_draw_leg_1_of_the_new_scro: You can draw leg 1 of the new scroll. No. 8 will hide in it too.
relay.could_not_open_a_new_scroll_refres: Could not open a new scroll. Refresh and try again.
relay.3_scrolls_are_already_in_progress_: 3 scrolls are already in progress. A new one can open once one finishes. Go rate and guess meanwhile.
relay.you_already_drew_a_leg_go_look_at_: You already drew a leg. Go look at the scroll.
relay.this_scroll_is_not_available_to_dr: This scroll is not available to draw in. Choose one marked available below.
relay.no_time_limit_and_you_only_see_the: No time limit, and you only see the tail of the previous leg. Only if you don’t draw for 24 hours does the leg go to someone else.
relay.after_you_submit_the_rightmost_6_c: After you submit, the rightmost 6 columns of your leg guide the next artist. If the next leg is the AI, those 6 columns go to an image tool to continue.
relay.background_clouds_the_eraser_paint: Background, clouds. The eraser paints this color
relay.draw_pixel_by_pixel_brush_1_to_4_p: Draw pixel by pixel; brush 1 to 4 pixels wide. Shortcut B.
relay.erases_back_to_the_background_colo: Erases back to the background color (cloud white). Shortcut E.
relay.fills_a_connected_area_of_one_colo: Fills a connected area of one color at once. Shortcut G.
relay.click_a_pixel_to_pick_up_its_color: Click a pixel to pick up its color. Shortcut I, or Alt+click.
relay.drag_out_a_straight_line_with_the_: Drag out a straight line. With the pen, Shift+click also joins a line. Shortcut L.
relay.drag_out_a_box_turn_on_solid_to_fi: Drag out a box; turn on Solid to fill it. Shortcut U.
relay.drag_out_a_circle_or_oval_turn_on_: Drag out a circle or oval; turn on Solid to fill it. Shortcut O.
relay.move_around_when_zoomed_in_shortcu: Move around when zoomed in. Shortcut H, or hold Space.
relay.zoom_up_to_6_ctrl_scroll_on_a_comp: Zoom up to 6×. Ctrl+scroll on a computer, two fingers on a phone.
relay.ctrl_z_to_undo_ctrl_y_to_redo_up_t: Ctrl+Z to undo, Ctrl+Y to redo, up to 40 steps.
relay.shows_a_line_around_every_pixel_to: Shows a line around every pixel to help you line things up.
relay.until_you_submit_every_stroke_is_s: Until you submit, every stroke is saved on this device. Close the page and your half-done leg is still there.
relay.b_pen_e_eraser_g_fill_i_picker_l_l: B pen, E eraser, G fill, I picker, L line, U rect, O ellipse, H hand, [ ] brush size, Ctrl+Z undo.
relay.on_phones_and_tablets_pinch_to_zoo: On phones and tablets, pinch to zoom and drag with two fingers to pan.
relay.as_long_as_you_draw_something_with: As long as you draw something within 24 hours, the leg stays yours.
relay.no_countdown_finish_it_over_as_man: No countdown. Finish it over as many sittings as you like.
relay.take_a_leg.label: Take a leg
relay.the_left_edge_of_your_canvas_shows: The left edge of your canvas shows the last 6 columns of the previous leg. Continue drawing right of the dashed line.
relay.48_64_pixels_16_colors_8_tools_no_: 48×64 pixels, 16 colors, 8 tools, no time limit. Submit when you’re happy.
relay.one_leg_from_2_to_8_is_drawn_by_ai: One leg from 2 to 8 is drawn by AI artist “No. 8”. After someone submits leg 1, the host places No. 8 in one of those legs. Rate every leg, guess which one, then see how everyone did at the reveal.
relay.canvas_preview_the_strip_on_the_le: Canvas preview: the strip on the left is the previous leg’s tail
relay.the_previous_leg_s_tail_continue_o: ↑ The previous leg’s tail; continue on the right (sample)
relay.someone_already_took_this_leg_pick: Someone already took this leg. Pick another.
relay.could_not_copy_automatically_the_t: Could not copy automatically. The text is in the box; copy it, then clear the box.
relay.parsed_strokes_preview_is_in_the_b: Parsed {valueA} strokes. Preview is in the box above.
relay.could_not_read_that_json_paste_the: Could not read that JSON. Paste the whole reply from Claude.
relay.tap_again_to_reveal_now_otherwise_: Tap again to reveal now (otherwise it reveals 24h after leg 8)
relay.ai_leg_only_you_can_see_this_leg: AI leg (only you can see this): leg {valueA},
relay.you_didn_t_draw_for_24_hours_so_th: You didn’t draw for 24 hours, so the leg went to someone else.
relay.sign_in_and_get_an_invite_from_the: Sign in and get an invite from the host to use this.
relay.checking.label: Checking…
relay.enter_the_passphrase_set_in_supaba: Enter the passphrase set in Supabase. Chinese passphrases are supported.
